services.desc: Location, location, location! This lodge is in the heart of bonefishing mecca. This Bahamas bonefishing lodge is located on the middle bight of Andros Island which is the bonefish capital of the world. It offers great guides, perfect location, professional hands on management, comfortable accommodations and excellent food. Other lodges may offer two or three of these items but rarely do you find all five of these in a Bahamas bonefishing lodge! This saltwater fly fishing lodge is located smack in the middle of the Andros fishery, the largest area of bonefish habitat in the world.
